headline: The fallout from a failed attempt to raise P.G. City Council compensation in 2025 continues with a new measure and an FPPC complaint.
summary: The aftermath of the Pacific Grove City Council vote in 2025 to increase councilmembers’ compensation continues to unfold, this time with the certification of a future ballot measure that would make it harder for future councils to increase their pay.
source: Monterey County Weekly / Monterey County NOW
